system_thesis_interpretation: Operationally, the proposal is a text-first, fixed-controller assay for a bounded portion of the project thesis. A frozen pretrained resolver and frozen prompted operation policy act through one arm-owned lifetime. Each arm sees the same presealed sequence of public opportunities but chooses its own diagnostic and instrumental actions, so its executed actions create its own ordinary public evidence. Scheduled offline Dream-1 calls commit local prospective claims before a block's outcomes; scheduled Dream-2 calls may retain, revise, abstain, or add after the raw public outcomes arrive; a deterministic sleeper records all model-owned decisions under syntax, provenance, chronology, deduplication, supersession, and fixed-view rules without selecting correctness. The resulting explicit per-life text snapshot is read by a bounded, goal-conditioned resolver to choose later world actions. The randomized fork isolates one pulse in which assigned memory changes a probe, the probe changes public evidence, the assigned object is removed, and only the branch event plus a common authentic prior may produce a later delta and sterile action. This realizes action-conditioned experience acquisition and explicit-memory reconsolidation over a finite synthetic causal map, not the mature Dream--LoRA--Think organism. The base and controller do not learn; LoRA, learned scheduling, learned exploration, materialized shortcuts, outer-loop controller learning, schema compression, and unbounded improvement are deferred. Thus a positive result would concern acquired per-life text content and the integrated prompted pipeline over the registered range, while the owner's broader better-at-longer-lifetimes hypothesis remains only partially tested.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph changes the controlled object from a shared fixed trajectory to shared opportunities with arm-owned trajectories. PCFL_ACTIVE_OPPORTUNITY_DECK owns fixed episode starts, goals, menus, costs, action caps, latent roots, and target allocation; ORDINARY_WAKE_ACTOR reads only its own public prefix and eligible memory, emits one legal action, and ORDINARY_ENVIRONMENT_EXECUTOR alone turns that action into a public result. DETERMINISTIC_EVENT_EXTRACTOR may derive literal witnessed atoms, but it cannot infer hidden mappings. DREAM1_PROPOSER writes prospective, target-blind model claims into preallocated source slots; DREAM2_REVISER writes model-owned lifecycle decisions only after the scheduled public outcome; SLEEP_COMPILER materializes an immutable explicit text snapshot. The audit/status/provenance graph is external state and not an answer-bearing cognitive graph. At a causal fork, FORK_ASSIGNER installs AUTH, TWIN, and NULL once each behind opaque capabilities in three isolated clones. DIAGNOSTIC_ACTOR may be affected only through its assigned reader. POSTFORK_RESETTER may inspect registry metadata but not semantic bytes and must destroy the assigned object, conversation, workspace, cursor, caches, and assignment-derived state. POSTFORK_DELTA_COMPILER then reads the common authentic prior, common Dream-1 bytes, and the one public branch event using assignment-independent paired draws. EVALUATION_INSTALLER creates exactly common prior plus sealed delta, and a fresh sterile actor executes a world-defined target. This blocks a direct assigned-memory-to-later-action edge. Explicit durable state consists of raw public events, witnessed atoms, SELF records, append-only lifecycle/status/supersession records, fixed source slots, snapshots, indexes, and resource/audit receipts. Temporary state consists of goal workspaces, adaptive query paths, conversations, cursors, and KV/provider caches and is destroyed at item, fork, or life boundaries. No parametric per-life state exists in the current paper graph: LoRA is a later, separately authorized transport node. The same-event and byte-identical common-history branches are essential attribution subgraphs: they distinguish raw action/outcome replay, action tokens, witnessed/mechanical atoms, native external memory, rolling summaries, and generic SELF; the class-informed condition is only a scaffold ceiling. Ordinary P4 differences are whole-pipeline effects because histories diverge; model-owned compiler credit can come only from P1's common-history, same-event, outcome, binding, and semantic-cut contrasts.
loop_delta_interpretation: Across one lifetime, fast state is the current public opportunity plus bounded workspace; medium state is append-only public experience and the explicit SELF/witness snapshot; the frozen base and prompted controller are unchanged. THINK is goal-directed and path-building: it may issue at most six local reads, adapt later queries to prior returns, update or backtrack a bounded path, and execute within twelve resolver operations and the target action cap. DREAM is broader only in the limited sense supported here: at each predeclared ordinary block it considers the block's public episode material and eligible prior memory, commits multiple local prospective candidates before outcomes, then revisits them after outcomes. The proposal does not establish free associative breadth, autonomous replay choice, or learned sleep pressure. SELF_AGGREGATION_V1 makes multi-sample search failure-inclusive: every allocated sample/proposal lineage occupies a stable slot; literal duplicates may share semantic identity while retaining all multiplicity receipts; nonidentical disagreements coexist as provisional records; malformed, abstained, timed-out, retry-exhausted, and missing outputs remain fixed status-only slots; no majority, confidence, correctness, utility, or result selector may choose a winner. ORDINARY_SLEEP_CADENCE_V1 makes the offline schedule content-blind: one Dream-1 at each enumerated block-open, one Dream-2 after the last included event, and one snapshot seal occur even on abstention or failure, with current, lagged, and first-acquisition snapshots determined by public deck order, event/token cutoffs, and no contradiction-, latency-, result-, or DEV-triggered extra call. SELF_LIFECYCLE_READER_V1 makes time and revision explicit: historical snapshots never change; only SELF_RETAINED and the active latest SELF_REVISED version in a lineage expose payload as READABLE_SELF; provisional, contradicted, abstained, malformed, failed, and superseded slots remain in the same candidate position and byte envelope but return a normalized SELF_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE. Disagreeing lineages can therefore remain simultaneously readable after separate model-owned retention/revision. Thinker attempts do not become durable evidence merely because they were generated: only actually executed ordinary actions and their public outcomes can enter PUBLIC_LIVED_EVENT, and only after the scheduled post-event boundary may Dream-2 and sleep derive memory. Evaluation thoughts and outcomes never re-enter. In the fork pulse, the diagnostic action/outcome becomes eligible only after treatment unmount and reset; assigned-memory content and temporary actor state cannot become evidence. Whole-organism credit belongs to the ordinary on-policy response surface; component credit is split among the public extractor, frozen model compiler, deterministic sleeper, memory backend/reader, and resolver by the registered factorials. Scheduling and stop behavior are rigid: no automatic stage transition, missed or failed calls consume assigned slots, failures stay zero, A0 nonadaptive sufficiency stops/narrows the construct, B0--B2 must pass before eight-root DEV expansion, and Stage C/D require later exact authority.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposal correctly retires fixed-source self-improvement and compression/unbounded-learning language. Its strongest eligible text claim is conditional on a later 26-root confirmation: within one frozen PCFL generator/model/controller family, model-owned target-blind text records must add representation-neutral integrative world-action value beyond the root-wise strongest legitimate same-history raw, recurrent-KV, mechanical, linked, or rolling comparator under a common online envelope; randomized AUTH/TWIN/NULL branches must pass every cumulative probe--information--new-evidence--readable-delta--working-path--terminal-action link after assigned-memory removal; and the ordinary SELF system must acquire NEW mappings at all three post-native checkpoints, demonstrate above-floor acquisition and 6L retention on the same OLD rows, and exceed the root-wise strongest RAG/AS-EXT/MECH cross-era AUC envelope. P1 localizes the narrow compiler/reconsolidation advantage; P2--P4 plus the ordinary on-policy histories describe the integrated system. None proves formal mediation, a natural indirect effect, learned cognition, higher-order schema induction, compression, external validity, generic SOTA superiority, or universal self-improvement. The four tests are an intersection claim, and the stated .951579 marginal and .806317 dependence-free joint values are prospective arithmetic, not evidence; confirmation remains unavailable if simultaneous SD-UCB, diagnostic, exact nested simulation, resource, or review gates fail. A4 world/action rows are completeness and integrity obligations for current text claims, but their revision efficacy is descriptive and cannot alter P1--P4. Stage D is not applicable to current text claims, so NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D is a passing not-applicable disposition and no LoRA artifact or parametric claim is licensed. A named baseline may be called plateaued only after its own two simultaneous equivalence intervals lie wholly inside [-.05,+.05] under its legitimate policy. September can contain only construct/protocol and labeled failure-inclusive eight-root DEV, never the later population claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix expresses a one-way information discipline. Private root/truth and target certificates live only in generator/certifier/scorer processes. Public opportunity bytes can reach the ordinary actor and environment; actually executed public events can reach extraction and scheduled Dream/sleep. Future target allocation, hidden truth, scorer/comparator verdicts, arm names, prior results, and DEV outputs cannot affect prompts, candidates, admission, lifecycle, cadence, retries, caches, filenames, errors, timing, or memory. Evaluation goals may influence only ephemeral typed query bytes inside a fresh target process; the query, return, and workspace die at item end. Fork assignment metadata is owned by the assigner and is readable by the resetter only as registry/capability existence metadata for destruction proof; the resetter cannot hash, serialize, compare, or forward semantic content. The delta compiler cannot read any assignment descendant, and P1 compiler seeds use only protocol/root/recipient-side/checkpoint/presealed pair-group/sample index. AUTH/TWIN/NULL share MAIN_FORK draws; intact SELF and same-probe twin-outcome share draws; stochastic common-history comparisons share COMMON_HISTORY draws; semantic cut/sham are deterministic transforms with no resampling. The trusted DEV selector sees only registered aggregates after all DEV cells seal and may choose one of two already frozen AS-EXT candidates plus a predeclared go/calibration/stop/resource disposition; it cannot change cognition or raw rows. Constant-shape closure is particularly important for the reworked SELF lifecycle: committed unavailable slots cannot disappear, reveal their reason, change order/length/candidate count, or reduce charged work. These are prospective contracts, not current implementation evidence: A1/A2 mutation tests, goldens, seed equality, cache/process/file-descriptor canaries, sterility, and fresh-life reset must still prove them before any scientific model call.
acceptance_test_interpretation: In list order, the first test measures whether the lifetime axis is a total, target-independent opportunity/target construction with an honest pre-native reference, strict post-native age, exact clone counts, and failure denominators; it is construct evidence, not model efficacy. The second tests whether ordinary D4 really needs four life bindings and whether the integrative target defeats direct, one-event, independent, and nonadaptive lookup while remaining representation-neutral; recurrent KV success is deliberately allowed and becomes a comparator, so the advertised link is adaptive finite-map use rather than SELF necessity. The third measures the randomized chain only if all three treatments run on both sides/checkpoints, unmount/reset succeeds, intended paired compiler draws are identical, all links are cumulative and failure-inclusive, and the same-event/binding/outcome/cut/common-history roster is complete; it supports a causal cascade, not formal mediation. The fourth tests model ownership and incremental compiler value by separating supplied extraction, deterministic witness/mechanical memory, raw/action-only lanes, matched outcomes, SELF semantics, and strong same-history alternatives while binding all sample/cadence/lifecycle policies before output. The fifth tests comparator fairness and one-way DEV selection, not superiority by itself: both native candidates and raw/MECH/KV controls must receive legitimate interfaces and all resource work must remain visible. The sixth measures the complete P1--P4 population decision at the world-life root level, including all minima/maxima and failures; the IUT, simultaneous variance bound, diagnostic, and exact scenario simulation are all needed, while the analytical planning powers are not observed evidence. The seventh tests whether the causal result can survive descendant leakage, assignment-derived RNG, treatment residue, goal-query persistence, selector backflow, status-shape channels, and cross-life state. The eighth measures stage/resource honesty: fixed roster and costs, no output-conditioned pruning, nonconfirmatory September labeling, and later exact authority; it does not make a feasible plan into evidence. The ninth is correctly an integrity-only current-text test: all preassigned A4 rows use world/action scoring and remain sterile/failure-inclusive, while any efficacy value including zero is compatible with the current claim. The tenth is correctly inapplicable to current text claims: NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D passes without an artifact, and only a future separately ratified LoRA proposal can activate the substantive sentinel. The eleventh tests reproducibility and claim containment while preserving approve-narrow, null, NOT_RUN, and reject as valid non-authorizing outcomes. The twelfth is the decisive premodel ownership test: it must bind the exact prompts/model/parser/reader/cuts/budgets/power code plus the executable multi-sample reducer, ordinary sleep cadence, checkpoint lifecycle/constant-shape reader, blindness goldens, and paired-seed implementation before B0, followed by fresh review and exact human model-call authority. Collectively these tests cover the advertised graph, loop, visibility, attribution, statistical, resource, and claim links, but passing protocol checks alone never establishes scientific success.
assumptions: The proposal and all thirty-seven declared context bindings remain byte-identical to the hashes recorded here for the lifetime of this interpretation.

The architecture-level names SELF_AGGREGATION_V1, ORDINARY_SLEEP_CADENCE_V1, SELF_LIFECYCLE_READER_V1, and P1_COMPILER_CRN_V1 denote mandatory future executable artifacts; their exact implementation bytes do not exist in or receive authority from this interpretation.
The common online envelope is a capability and work-limit comparison, not a claim that backend-native records, preprocessing, offline compute, or total resources are byte- or compute-equal.

Episode reset makes later opportunity starts comparable across arms while intentionally preserving arm-owned memory and public history; within-episode trajectory differences are part of the ordinary whole-system treatment.
Every scientific failure after assignment is scored in place as specified, while environment-wide NOT_RUN is available only before the first scientific dispatch.
P1 pair groups and recipient side are fixed before assignment, and no runtime alias, capability, lane, method, execution order, or treatment identity can enter their seed derivation.

The exact 908-row arithmetic counts target-evaluation rows only; diagnostic actions, compiler calls, resolver operations, and training or preprocessing work remain nested resource items rather than replicates.
The applicability file is intended to normatively narrow the coarse required_before enum for current text claims.

The A2 table must settle all ties before B0 without using meaning, contradiction, success, latency, or DEV data.

ambiguities.question: When several separately retained or revised disagreeing SELF lineages are simultaneously READABLE_SELF for one query key, what exact target-independent index order and one-record return policy chooses which slot is returned across successive calls?
ambiguities.impact: Preserving disagreement is architecturally sound, but a hidden confidence, status, recency, or correctness rank in the reader could recreate the forbidden reducer. SELF_LIFECYCLE_READER_V1 must bind ordering, cursor behavior, repeated-query behavior, and constant work.

ambiguities.question: Does the statement that checkpoint catalog/return policy is identical across methods apply only to SELF lifecycle counterfactuals and paired lanes, or literally to native RAW-AO, RAG, linked, rolling, witness, MECH, and SELF representations?
ambiguities.impact: Literal cross-backend shape identity conflicts with the explicitly permitted backend-native event envelopes and interfaces; too narrow a reading could leave status or candidate-count channels. A2 should distinguish lifecycle constant-shape invariants from legitimate representation-specific payload schemas while keeping the common call/query/return-byte/operation/action caps and full resource accounting.

ambiguities.question: What exact frozen ordinary action policy, within-episode state transition, backtrack/defer semantics, memory-query state, and cost accounting will every arm use after its public history diverges?
ambiguities.impact: Episode reset and common opportunities protect later starts, but the causal meaning of Q, information gain, and P4 still depends on an exact shared actor/environment contract. A0--A2 must certify that only intended memory/history differences, not arm-specific harness behavior, cause opportunity use and failures.

ambiguities.question: How is the same-probe twin-side outcome packet certified as a valid public intervention for the recipient before-state while keeping every non-outcome Dream-2 byte identical?
ambiguities.impact: The contract requires execution rather than hidden-truth substitution, but mismatched handles, costs, terminal flags, or after-state semantics could make the outcome intervention detect malformed world state rather than causal evidence. A1 fixtures must certify the cross-side packet mapping and the exact sole byte differences.

ambiguities.question: What machine-readable alias maps claim_test_applicability.json names such as C1_MODEL_OWNED_TEXT_MEMORY and C2_ACTION_CONDITIONED_CAUSAL_CASCADE to the claim_delta identifiers such as C_PCFL_ACTION_CONDITIONED_CAUSAL_CASCADE and the statistics claim ladder?

The later claim manifest should bind one canonical identifier or an explicit immutable alias map before review.

ambiguities.question: Which general operations, ontology fields, relation types, and join hints will the world-family-blind prompt and DSL expose, and what exact distinction will separate it from the class-informed ceiling?
ambiguities.impact: Twins hide life bindings but do not prevent a human-authored prompt from supplying the solution procedure. The current claim is allowed to be a frozen prompted system claim, yet compiler attribution and the generic-versus-class-informed falsifier require exact published bytes and a fresh judgment that the generic policy does not encode the PCFL sufficient program.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed Paper-1 system should not be described as the Dream--LoRA--Think organism itself, even if its text-only causal cascade passes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The paper surface has explicit text memory, a frozen prompted compiler/controller, fixed cadence, supplied extraction, and no per-life LoRA or learned loop policy. It tests an action-conditioned text-memory organ and a bounded system pulse, while the thesis assigns a conditional transport role to LoRA and later learning to the shared controller/scheduler.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use PCFL-Active-Stream or prompted action-conditioned compiled-text system in all current diagrams and claims; reserve Dream--LoRA--Think organism language for a future separately powered proposal that actually includes and attributes the LoRA and learned-loop organs.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Continued success over independent thirteen-mapping cohorts is evidence for finite causal-map acquisition, retention, and fixed-budget use, not connected schema discovery, compression, or increasing learned reasoning depth.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Persistent family labels and bounded recurrent reads permit a legitimate finite-map implementation. The proposal acknowledges this in several contracts, but phrases such as remembered life-specific structure, continual learning, and model-owned reconsolidation can still be read more broadly than the ordinary world identifies.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the exact finite synthetic causal-map qualifier adjacent to every C1--C3 claim and report witness, SELF, and path structure separately; require the separate prospective-schema rung or endpoint-held edge intervention before any abstraction, compression, or learned-connection claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The ordinary P4 on-policy advantage cannot be used to credit the SELF compiler, because each arm's evidence, representation, retrieval, and later actions co-evolve.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Shared opportunities preserve a meaningful whole-system comparison, not a same-input module comparison. A higher SELF cross-era AUC can arise from earlier actions, accumulated public history, memory organization, reader behavior, or resolver use. Only P1's byte-identical common-history and same-event interventions can isolate incremental compiler/reconsolidation value.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Label P4 strictly as integrated on-policy pipeline value and make every compiler sentence depend on the P1 common-history, RAW/action/witness, matched-outcome, semantic-cut, binding, and strongest-comparator components.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A frozen model choosing among prompt-defined prospective/revision operations is model-owned generation, but it is not a learned compiler, autonomous dream policy, or self-learned cognition.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The operation grammar, cadence, query interface, sample budget, reducer, lifecycle, and stop rules are human-designed and frozen; only per-life explicit content changes. The class-informed ceiling helps detect direct PCFL scaffolding but cannot make the generic prompted policy learned.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use model-owned prompted prospective/revision compiler for current attribution, forbid learned/autonomous wording, and require an across-life trained LOOP/compiler policy with held-out-life evaluation before those terms become eligible.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The 26-root analytical arithmetic does not establish that the actual non-smooth P1--P4 system is 80%-powered.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: P1 and P2/P3 use pointwise minima, P4 uses a root-wise maximum, failures can create atoms and zero inflation, and eight DEV roots weakly constrain variance. The proposal correctly introduces simultaneous SD-UCB, diagnostics, and exact nested simulations, so any summary wording that presents .951579 or .806317 as achieved design power would outrun its own gate.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Always label those numbers prospective normal-theory planning arithmetic; allow Stage C only if the exact composite simulator, every registered tail/dependence/failure scenario, SD-UCB, diagnostic, resources, and independent review pass without changing roots or cells.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Exceeding named baselines under the six-read/query-byte/return-byte/operation/action envelope cannot support generic SOTA, efficiency, or equal-compute language.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Native preprocessing, index construction, model calls, storage, compiler work, and amortization differ by condition, and the tested implementations live inside one synthetic PCFL family. Equal online caps are scientifically useful but do not erase those resource and scope differences.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Name only exact frozen comparators, report the complete offline-plus-online resource vectors and losing DEV candidate, keep efficiency descriptive, and require a future powered resource-frontier proposal for any efficiency or broad system-ranking claim.

open_questions: Does Rohin ratify these exact proposal bytes only as a narrow finite synthetic action-conditioned text-memory design, while preserving separate authority for implementation, A0--A2 evidence, scientific model calls, Stage C, and any later LoRA work?

Does Rohin accept that the current paper surface is not the full Dream--LoRA--Think organism and cannot support learned-controller, autonomous-dreaming, compression, generic-SOTA, naturalistic, human-like, or unbounded-learning language?

If nonadaptive witness KV solves the integrative construct, or if recurrent KV/raw/MECH/linked/rolling memory matches generic SELF on byte-identical history, should the project stop or publish the narrower finite causal-memory benchmark/null rather than weaken the comparator or add a post-hoc target?

Before B0, which exact A2 reducer keys and capacities, ordinary block/cutoff schedule, disagreement-reader ordering, lifecycle slot policy, generic/scaffold prompts, native baseline implementations, and scientific model/provider/resource scope should be independently reviewed and explicitly authorized?
Should the later claim manifest adopt one canonical claim-ID namespace or bind an exact alias map so T09 integrity-only and T10 not-applicable semantics cannot be misapplied by downstream tooling?

Does Rohin accept that September 25 can contain only the released construct/protocol and labeled eight-root DEV/falsification package, with no P1--P4 population claim, and that the 26-root confirmation remains post-deadline and conditional on the full power/resource/review gates?
